prompt:
Translate the Swedish product description in the user message into English. The source ends before the optional trailing Additional glossary section. Read that section as an extension of the fixed glossary, with the same required and forbidden wording; do not translate or reproduce the section itself.

Build the English clauses around the required terms. When Swedish uses a glossary entry as a base word, in an inflected form, or inside a compound, choose the required English word or phrase first and fit the surrounding grammar to it. If a direct sentence structure would call for an adverb, a derived adjective, or a different noun, recast the sentence instead of changing the required term. Keep required words separate from adjacent letters, digits, and underscores; English compounds may use spaces or hyphens. Use the listed spelling, with ordinary plural or possessive endings where appropriate. Preserve each repeated mention in the same required terminology, and keep every member of an inline enumeration. For every applicable entry, exclude its forbidden alternatives throughout the translation, including their ordinary inflected forms and uses in other senses.

Translate all source information without adding or summarising. Copy brand and product names exactly and preserve paragraph breaks. Aim for an English word count near 1.15 times the Swedish source word count, excluding the glossary. Return just the English prose, starting with the translated opening and ending with the translated ending. No Markdown, headings, list markers, framing, or notes.
